I’m from China and I completed my undergraduate studies in Computer Science and Biology at McGill University. After graduation, I worked as a software engineer at Block and StraitsX for 3 years. These experiences developed my interest in data, problem-solving, and building practical solutions. Through the MDS program, I hope to strengthen my analytical skills and learn how to apply them to real-world problems.
